what: UGI distributes energy: regulated natural gas and electricity utilities in Pennsylvania, propane distribution through AmeriGas across America, and energy marketing in Europe.
customers: Households and businesses on regulated gas and electricity, and propane customers off the gas network.
money: propane delivered to homes and businesses
regulated gas and electricity in Pennsylvania
moat: The regulated Pennsylvania utility earns a guaranteed return, and propane customers depend on delivery to tanks that the supplier owns, which makes switching inconvenient.
risks: $7.4B of debt against $483M of cash, much of it at AmeriGas
Propane volumes decline structurally as homes convert to gas and electricity
Revenue fell from $10.1B to $7.3B as energy prices normalised
opportunities: 11.3 times earnings and analysts see about 24% upside
The regulated Pennsylvania utility provides stable, growing earnings regardless of propane
A 9.5% net margin and $272M of free cash flow
watch: AmeriGas volumes and the Pennsylvania utility's rate base growth.
